basic_info.description: $275k Price Reduction for 15 DAYS - BRING an OFFER!   Prime Development Opportunity in the Heart of the Mission    Welcome to 3236 24th Street, a fully entitled development site in one of San Francisco's most vibrant and culturally rich neighborhoods. Spanning 4,468 square feet, this shovel-ready parcel is approved for a five-story residential building featuring 17 thoughtfully designed unitsa mix of studio and two-bedroom layoutsalong with 1,662 square feet of ground floor commercial space ideal for retail or caf use.    The project presents an exceptional opportunity for developers and investors alike, with the potential to build as an entirely market-rate development. The future owner may also elect to opt out of on-site affordability requirements via the Easter Neighborhoods Alternate Affordable Housing Fee, offering added flexibility and upside.    With its central location on bustling 24th Street, surrounded by local eateries, shops, BART access, and dynamic street life, this project is perfectly positioned to meet the growing demand for quality housing in San Francisco's Mission District.
